newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT-JGBs seen trying for record high of 127.34.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-JGBs seen trying for record high of 127.34.

text.p: FUTURE RANGE/DAY SPPRT RSTNC RSI-9 MA-5 MA-25
OUTLOOK OF BOJ OPERATION AT 0020 GMT: Injection of 200 bln yen
*Key September 10-year Japanese government bond (JGB) futures likely to try all-time high for any benchmark contract of 127.34 on Wednesday as recent firm tone continues.
*Some said contract may rise towards 127.50 while others afraid MOF may set coupon rate for 10-year JGB auction next week at record low 2.2 percent if it rises that high.
